purpose: Compare five-node Case 2 dispatch trees at fleets 23-26 on three team-shared strongly connected directions.
answer_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 with LF line endings as stored in Git.
aggregation: Pool completed pickups after warmup and compute cost once with a floor-index urgent P95. One rejected seed invalidates the pooled cost.

descriptions.PJH: Enumerate every five-node ancestor-closed subtree of the team 6-node answer; cross both with the PJH and JSM directions.
descriptions.JSM5: Evaluate the team-shared five-node answer on its native JSM direction and the PJH direction.
descriptions.JSM3: Add one urgent rule and one short-trip nonurgent rule in a 2-by-2 design, with the native JSM direction.
descriptions.KMJ: Enumerate every five-node ancestor-closed subtree of the KMJ nine-node answer, with its native KMJ direction.
descriptions.MAIN: Re-evaluate the old main answer on its published fleet and direction as a reference.

duplicate_check.outcome: No matching pooled 1-50 run for this case and candidate set. JSM B1/B2 report 11-15 and 2400001-2400020 in five-seed batches; main, PJH and KMJ shared rows report 11-15 and 1-500.

logs: Unmodified score.cjs stdout; trace contains assignment count and hash, and lists rejected seeds.
